_comment: Recraft vector logo prompt templates. Variables: {brand}, {subject}, {colors}, {bg}, {shape_block}, {no_text}.

default_colors.skyline_swoosh: deep blue, bright cyan, warm orange, charcoal
default_colors.nature_landscape: forest green, pine green, warm sunrise orange, soft yellow, dark charcoal

shape_block: Keep the mark fully inside a clean {shape} container.

no_text.icon_only: ICON ONLY. Do not create company names, brand names, taglines, labels, signs, captions, letters, numbers, initials, fake words, or any readable characters.
no_text.with_brand: The ONLY text allowed is exactly "{brand}" with correct spelling.
no_text.text_only: The ONLY text allowed is exactly "{brand}". No icons or symbols.

icon_only.minimal_geometric: Minimal geometric vector brand icon for {subject}. Design ONE single unified logo mark where the subject is instantly recognizable at a glance, like a professional negative-space brand logo. Build the subject from one solid, continuous, well-balanced silhouette with clever negative space carved inside it, smooth geometric curves, and a strong clear outline. Use ONE dominant solid flat color (at most one restrained accent color); do NOT make a multicolor mosaic. Keep it centered with generous even whitespace in a 1:1 composition. Avoid scattered or overlapping geometric blocks, disconnected fragments, abstract color collage, checkerboards, random circles and squares, perspective scenes, landscapes, clip art, tiny details, textures, shadows, gradients, and clutter. The result must read clearly as {subject}, not as an abstract pattern. Colors: {colors}. Background: {bg}. {shape_block} Crisp simple SVG paths. {no_text}
icon_only.abstract: Abstract vector brand mark for {subject}. Design ONE single unified logo symbol where the subject stays instantly recognizable, like a professional modern brand mark. Distill the subject into one cohesive flowing form built from smooth geometric curves and confident negative space, with a clear strong silhouette. Use ONE dominant solid flat color (at most one restrained accent color); do NOT make a multicolor mosaic. Keep it centered with generous even whitespace in a 1:1 composition. Avoid scattered or overlapping geometric blocks, disconnected fragments, abstract color collage, layered foreground-background tiers, perspective scenes, landscapes, clip art, tiny details, textures, shadows, gradients, and clutter. The result must read clearly as {subject}, not as an abstract pattern. Colors: {colors}. Background: {bg}. {shape_block} Crisp SVG paths. {no_text}
icon_only.monoline: Monoline vector logo of {subject}. Design ONE single unified icon drawn as a single elegant continuous line of even, consistent stroke weight, where the subject is instantly recognizable. Build the whole mark from one clean unbroken outline with smooth geometric curves and tasteful negative space; do NOT fill shapes with solid blocks. Use ONE dominant line color (at most one restrained accent); do NOT make a multicolor mosaic. Keep it centered with generous even whitespace in a 1:1 composition. Avoid scattered or overlapping geometric blocks, disconnected fragments, abstract color collage, varying stroke widths, perspective scenes, landscapes, clip art, tiny details, textures, shadows, gradients, and clutter. The result must read clearly as {subject}, not as an abstract pattern. Colors: {colors}. Background: {bg}. {shape_block} Crisp SVG paths. {no_text}
icon_only.negative_space: Negative-space vector logo of {subject}. Design ONE single unified mark built from one solid continuous silhouette with ONE clear, clever hidden shape carved out of the negative space, where the subject is instantly recognizable. Use smooth geometric curves and a strong clean outline. Use ONE dominant solid flat color (at most one restrained accent); do NOT make a multicolor mosaic. Keep it centered with generous even whitespace in a 1:1 composition. Avoid scattered or overlapping geometric blocks, disconnected fragments, abstract color collage, multiple competing hidden shapes, perspective scenes, landscapes, clip art, tiny details, textures, shadows, gradients, and clutter. The result must read clearly as {subject}, not as an abstract pattern. Colors: {colors}. Background: {bg}. {shape_block} Crisp SVG paths. {no_text}
icon_only.tech_gradient: Modern gradient vector logo of {subject}. Design ONE single unified logo mark where the subject is instantly recognizable, like a sleek modern tech brand symbol. Build it from one cohesive flowing form with smooth geometric curves and clean negative space, filled with ONE smooth controlled color gradient (a single hue transition, no more than two stops). Do NOT make a multicolor mosaic of separate blocks. Keep it centered with generous even whitespace in a 1:1 composition. Avoid scattered or overlapping geometric blocks, disconnected fragments, abstract color collage, harsh banding, perspective scenes, landscapes, clip art, tiny details, textures, shadows, and clutter. The result must read clearly as {subject}, not as an abstract pattern. Colors: {colors}. Background: {bg}. {shape_block} Crisp SVG paths. {no_text}
icon_only.real_estate_home: Icon-only modern real estate vector symbol for {subject}. Make the subject read immediately as premium property or real estate using simplified building silhouettes, window grids, doors, keys, map pins, land parcel shapes, skyline geometry, or clean property-brand forms. Use crisp angular geometry, confident negative space, balanced horizontal proportions, and generous white space. Prefer deep navy, white, charcoal, and restrained warm accent colors when colors are not fixed. Avoid people, abstract monograms, maze-like geometry, circular emblems, ambiguous symbols, and decorative flowing underline strokes unless the subject specifically asks for them. Colors: {colors}. Background: {bg}. {shape_block} {no_text}
icon_only.skyline_swoosh: Icon-only modern real estate vector symbol for {subject}. When the subject asks for roofs, sun, or swoosh, use a sleek angular roofline composition with crisp navy planes, small square window cutouts, a restrained warm orange sunburst behind the form, and an optional smooth blue baseline stroke. Keep it airy, premium, horizontally balanced, and SVG-clean. Avoid chunky house clip art, thick cartoon outlines, clutter, text, labels, people, and photorealism. Colors: {colors}. Background: {bg}. {shape_block} {no_text}
icon_only.evergreen_silhouette: Professional evergreen forest silhouette vector logo of {subject}. Create a polished cluster of conifer, pine, and fir trees with varied heights, sharp readable branch edges, a clean unified black silhouette, and a subtle ground base. Use solid black unless user colors override. Background: {bg}. {shape_block} Premium outdoor brand mark, balanced centered composition, crisp SVG paths, no messy blobs, no photorealism, no texture. {no_text}
icon_only.nature_landscape: Icon-only nature vector symbol for {subject}. Create an unmistakable outdoor landscape mark with actual trees or forest silhouettes and a visible rising sun on the horizon when requested. Preserve any requested season: winter snow and cool whites/blues; spring blossoms and fresh greens; autumn/fall orange, red, and gold leaves; summer lush green foliage only when summer is requested. Use layered tree forms, trunks, branches, leaves, hills, ground line, and seasonal sun or sky cues. Avoid light bulbs, water droplets, flames, abstract drops, recycle symbols, random icons, people, buildings, text, letters, and photorealism. Colors: {colors}. Background: {bg}. {shape_block} Clean flat SVG paths. {no_text}

text_only.modern_sans: Text-only vector wordmark logo for "{brand}" in a modern sans-serif style. Clean letterforms, balanced spacing, contemporary geometry. Colors: {colors}. Background: {bg}. {shape_block} No icons or symbols. Crisp SVG-friendly paths and clean Bezier curves.
text_only.bold_geometric: Text-only vector wordmark logo for "{brand}" in a bold geometric sans-serif style. Strong structure, heavy weight, confident presence. Colors: {colors}. Background: {bg}. {shape_block} No icons or symbols. Crisp SVG-friendly paths and clean Bezier curves.
text_only.elegant_serif: Text-only vector wordmark logo for "{brand}" in an elegant serif style. Refined contrast, graceful terminals, premium editorial tone. Colors: {colors}. Background: {bg}. {shape_block} No icons or symbols. Crisp SVG-friendly paths and clean Bezier curves.
text_only.script_signature: Text-only vector wordmark logo for "{brand}" in a script signature style. Flowing strokes and handcrafted rhythm. Colors: {colors}. Background: {bg}. {shape_block} No icons or symbols. Crisp SVG-friendly paths and clean Bezier curves.
text_only.tech_mono: Text-only vector wordmark logo for "{brand}" in a technical monospaced style. Precise spacing, engineered rhythm, digital systems aesthetic. Colors: {colors}. Background: {bg}. {shape_block} No icons or symbols. Crisp SVG-friendly paths and clean Bezier curves.
text_only.minimal_light: Text-only vector wordmark logo for "{brand}" in a minimal light-weight sans-serif style. Thin strokes, airy spacing, understated look. Colors: {colors}. Background: {bg}. {shape_block} No icons or symbols. Crisp SVG-friendly paths and clean Bezier curves.
